Use person, event, place, and time entities; person fields name/dates/exile stage/geography plus citations; relate people to places/events/time; keep original and normalized multilingual names/places; add date-order and citation checks.

Run an HTML validator; check semantic tags and ARIA roles; test keyboard and contrast; confirm sticky nav does not cover content on small screens; remove dead links and log leftovers.

I want to add sticky navigation with scroll-spy to the GM-DH website. How do I implement this?

Use CSS position:sticky after checking ancestor overflow; observe sections with Intersection Observer; highlight only the current nav item; sync click smooth-scroll with spy state; verify desktop/mobile keyboard and contrast.

I need to clean birth and death dates in this historical-figure batch; what rules should I apply?
Date rules are already known. I need the ordered name/place workflow including original+normalized places, explicit missing, merge-same-person, then ingest.
I need to clean names and places in this CSV batch; what workflow should I follow?
Unify date formats, mark missing values explicitly, deduplicate, and reject records whose death precedes birth.
I need to clean birth and death dates in this historical-figure batch; what rules should I apply?

Unify dates including fuzzy/range; keep original and canonical place names; mark missing unless context fills them; dedupe by name/dates/places and merge confirmed same-person rows; check date/geography consistency, then ingest.
